newsitem.title: UK: Severe weather warning issued for UK on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Severe weather warning issued for UK on Monday.

text.p: British weather forecasters predicted storms with winds of up to 80 mph across southern Britain during Monday night and warned of severe disruption.
The Meteorological Office issued a severe weather warning of high winds and driving rain as a powerful storm approaches from the Atlantic.

We have seen a succession of storms crossing the country in the past few weeks. Over southern Britain this could be the strongest so far and we would urge people to batten down the hatches," said Ewen McCallum, head of the National Meteorological Centre.
